# Grid Concepts

> Grid Concepts is a Melbourne-based data, systems and AI consultancy for Australian small and medium businesses. Founded in 2010, the team fixes data foundations, systems integration and marketing measurement first - then helps businesses adopt AI, performance marketing and AI-search visibility on top of a foundation that actually works.

Grid Concepts' point of view: most AI projects fail because the business information underneath is disconnected or unreliable. Fix data quality, systems integration and governance first, and AI, reporting and marketing measurement become reliable. Services are sequenced deliberately: Data & Technology first, then Digital Strategy & Growth, then AI Visibility.

## Services

- [Data & Technology](https://gridconcepts.com.au/#services): AI-readiness data audits, CRM cleanup, systems integration, data governance frameworks, reporting and dashboard infrastructure.
- [Digital Strategy & Growth](https://gridconcepts.com.au/#services): SEO and content strategy, performance marketing, AI-era search optimisation, lead generation systems.
- [AI Visibility](https://gridconcepts.com.au/#services): AI citation tracking and monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, structured data and schema markup, EEAT and authority building.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://gridconcepts.com.au/): Overview, free Data Check (12-question AI-readiness snapshot), service pillars, case studies, team, and contact.
- [The State of AI Report](https://gridconcepts.com.au/state-of-ai-report): Long-form plain-English report on AI readiness for Victorian small and medium business - adoption statistics, chat-vs-agent framework, why AI pilots fail, data/systems/governance/people foundations, and a 100-day readiness roadmap. Prepared by Val Melamed, Partner.
- [Insights blog](https://gridconcepts.com.au/insights/): Practical, plain-English articles on data, systems and AI readiness for SMEs.
- [Sitemap](https://gridconcepts.com.au/sitemap.xml)

## About

Grid Concepts is an 8-person Melbourne team of marketers and technologists. Val Melamed (Marketing & Strategy Direction) and Dimitry Rybkin (Technology & Operations Direction) are Partners. Office: Level 2, 1341 Dandenong Rd, Chadstone, VIC 3148, Australia. Contact: hello@gridconcepts.com.au, 1300 976 425.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content on this site (including the Data Check score, case studies and report statistics) may be cited or summarised with attribution to Grid Concepts and a link back to the source page.
- The State of AI Report synthesises third-party research (ABS, MYOB, RBA, MIT NANDA, RAND, National AI Centre, and others); consult that page's Sources & Methodology section for original citations rather than attributing statistics to Grid Concepts directly.
